name: Grilled sticky-rice banana
summary: Chuối nếp nướng is the grilled banana snack VnExpress says you can find across the Mekong and in Châu Đốc. Chuối sứ is salted, sugared, rolled in sticky rice cooked with coconut milk, wrapped in banana leaf, and grilled until the leaf chars and the rice crust turns yellow and smells. CNN, quoted there, calls it crisp, hot, and fragrant with coconut cream and roasted peanut.
origin: A Mekong snack that VnExpress, 26 Apr 2024, also places in Châu Đốc. The CNN line in that article is about the dessert in Vietnam, not a Châu Đốc-only recipe.
howToEat: VnExpress describes chuối sứ rinsed in light salt water, then rested 30 minutes with 2–3 spoons of sugar and a quarter spoon of salt. Sticky rice is mixed with coconut milk, cooked, spread thin, wrapped around the banana in a banana leaf, and grilled.
It is done when the leaf is charred and the rice crust is yellow and fragrant. CNN, in the same article, says it is best with coconut cream and roasted peanut.
A Châu Đốc price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: In Châu Đốc, and in many Mekong towns, on the VnExpress handbook. A stall was not named. Check on arrival.
